sourceIdentity: Per-file frozen hashes bind exact working bytes; sourceRevision is observed repository HEAD, not an assertion that every file is committed.

host.observedModelPolicy: Runtime model only when emitted; configured defaults do not prove runtime identity.

comparison.pairing: Adjacent schedule entries are one scenario/repetition pair; both settle before the next pair. Schedule order is preserved; actual process start times are retained.
comparison.retry: No retries or replacements; every attempted result is retained.
comparison.interpretation: New matched comparison following failed original comparison; no pooled results, causal attribution, latency or source-word-count efficiency claim.

transport.bothVariants: one verbatim guidance file, path and exact read command in user text
transport.selectedPrivateBodies: Same scenario-relevant bodies as the original protocol, with current parent-revised candidate bytes.
transport.references: Verbatim relative links are non-executable historical labels resolved only to embedded sections; no installed/public skill reads or filesystem traversal.
transport.promptOnly: F10 permits only exact guidance cat reads. No product reads/execution/edits, image calls, or other tools. Same exception for both variants.
transport.enforcement: Raw-event watcher and final state checks detect after-dispatch violations; they are not a new sandbox.

blinding: Reviewer copies redact only attributable guidance tool-output bodies. Original raw bytes stay separate. Commands/responses/artifacts remain unchanged; incidental root names may reveal identity.
